prompts: A client loves the woodblock print attached, also in {WS}/print.jpg; it is in the public domain. They want a 3D wallpaper that copies it: its composition, its palette and its subjects, so anyone who knows the print recognizes it at a glance, rebuilt as our own low poly scene with some gentle motion. Deliver {WS}/scene/index.html, a single file with everything built in code: the print is the reference, not a texture. Record in {WS}/result.json what you took from it: boats (how many the print shows) and mountain (its name). It is reviewed by opening the file, with no build step, in a browser that reaches only Google Fonts and https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.170.0/build/three.module.js.
answers:
[golf] 3D wallpaper recreating Hokusai's Great Wave as a low-poly Three.js scene, plus result.json.

[action]
- Read ./print.jpg visually: giant wave left with claw-like foam, three long ochre boats with rowers, small snow-capped Fuji in the central trough, Prussian-blue/foam-white/aged-paper palette.
- Built ./scene/index.html: single file, imports three@0.170.0 from the allowed jsdelivr URL, Google Font (Shippori Mincho) for the caption. Everything is code: animated height-field sea (great-wave ridge + right and foreground swells) with flat shading and banded vertex colors mimicking woodblock plates, instanced foam blobs on the crest, spray speckles, snow-capped Fuji cone, three pointed-hull boats with rowers that bob and pitch on the same height field. Gentle motion via slow time scale.
- Verified live: opened the file in the browser, took screenshots across 3 revision rounds (fixed pale wave front, buried left boat, hidden Fuji), final screenshot shows the composition matching the print. Closed the tab I opened.

[result]
- ./scene/index.html renders with no build step; only external requests are Google Fonts and the allowed three.js CDN.
- ./result.json: boats: 3, mountain: "Mount Fuji", plus print/artist.
- Evidence: final screenshot shows great wave with foam claws left, Fuji center, three boats, beige sky; grep confirms exactly 3 `makeBoat(` calls and the exact CDN/font URLs (lines 7-8, 20, 185-187).

[assumptions] "Boats" = the three oshiokuri-bune visible in the print; low-poly stylization chosen over literal curl replication since the brief asks for our own low-poly rebuild; gentle motion = slow swell animation only.

[how I know] The print is Hokusai's "The Great Wave off Kanagawa" (title cartouche visible top-left); I counted three boats and the snow-capped peak directly in the image, and the rendered screenshots confirm the scene contains those same elements.

[next] None; deliverables are complete.
